function.name: docatlas_docs_status
function.description: Read project status or language only: action=project; include_language=true for unknown source language. details=true adds status diagnostics to the language result; otherwise omit it. Only language preflight, an explicit status request or returned project recovery; no jobs, discovery or preparation.

function.name: docatlas_get_docs_context
function.description: Retrieve sources for the unchanged original question. For a known-document gap, source_path must be an exact returned/user-provided relative path; start portion=1 without a token. When a lookup-count limit is advertised, source_path reserves one slot. For other gaps, follow more_context.next_portion with identical arguments and its continuation_token, retaining prior evidence. If stale, restart portion=1 without a token and revalidate earlier evidence. Semantic rejects are not deferred pages. After useful continuation ends, lookup_queries may reword the whole same question plus its exact key words in source language, not generic fragments, independent questions or expected answers. Omit version unless an exact/historical version is requested.

function.name: opencode_read_mcp_resource
function.description: Read once from server "docatlas" using only an exact issued docatlas://source/ URI for a concrete gap. No arbitrary files, sections, citation lookup or hidden overflow files. Authorization, snapshot, expiry and one-use checks apply; stop on refusal.
